Conversation.title: Conversation
Conversation.description: A chat session between the user and Jarvis.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the conversation owner.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when conversation was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when conversation was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: A single message within a Jarvis conversation.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the message owner.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when message was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

CalendarEvent.title: CalendarEvent
CalendarEvent.description: A user calendar event managed by Jarvis and synced with the device calendar.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the event owner.

startTimeMillis.description: Event start time in UTC epoch milliseconds.

endTimeMillis.description: Event end time in UTC epoch milliseconds.

deviceEventId.description: Optional Android CalendarContract event ID (0 if cloud-only).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when event was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when event was updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

SmartDevice.title: SmartDevice
SmartDevice.description: A home smart device managed through Jarvis.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the device owner.

name.description: Friendly device name such as Living Room Light.

room.description: Room name where the device is located.

isOn.description: Whether the device is currently on or unlocked/active.

level.description: Percentage level (0-100) for lights or fans.

targetTemp.description: Target temperature in Fahrenheit (40-100) for thermostats.

entityId.description: Optional Home Assistant entity_id for real hub sync.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when device was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when device was updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/conversations/{conversat.description: User-owned messages inside a Jarvis conversation.
